UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

Washington, D.C. 20549

FORM 8-K

CURRENT REPORT

Date of Report (Date of earliest event reported): October 20, 2026

Unusual Machines, Inc.

Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets.

On October 20, 2026, Unusual Machines, Inc. (the “Company”) completed the acquisition of all of the membership interests of DroneNX LLC d/b/a Upgrade Energy, a Florida limited liability company (“Upgrade Energy”), pursuant to a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement (the “Purchase Agreement”) by and among the Company, Upgrade Energy and Matthew Barnard (“Seller”). The purchase price was $3.0 million in shares of the Company’s common stock.

Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.

(d) Exhibits. 99.1 Press release dated October 23, 2026.

SIGNATURES

Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed.
